snippet.title: Pecking Order - Steam Playtest Announcement | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description: Run, fly and scream your way through the food chain in this chaotic party game for up to 16 players, where sneaky worms outsmart hungry birds in a frantic fight for survival and bragging rights. Think you can climb your way to the top of the Pecking Order?
